topic: The anime banned in 30 countries because of a single scene
hook: One scene got this anime banned in 30 countries.
script: One scene got this anime banned in 30 countries. Pokémon's episode Dennō Senshi Porygon triggered 685 seizures in Japanese children in 1997. Strobing red and blue lights at 12 flashes per second caused photosensitive epilepsy in viewers. The episode was permanently banned worldwide. Pikachu was blamed despite Porygon being the character featured. Porygon has never appeared in the anime again — despite being innocent. Follow for anime controversies that changed broadcasting laws forever.
